usage: The noun '今個星期' is used to refer to the current week.
It can be used to talk about plans, events, or actions happening within this week.
You can place '今個星期' at the beginning or middle of a sentence to indicate the time frame.
It does not need a measure word before it, as it already specifies a time period.
Common verbs like '去' (go), '做' (do), or '會' (will) can be paired with '今個星期' to form meaningful sentences.
